about: Phrases Whisper is known to write over silence, music or noise (it learned them from subtitle credits). tools/listen/transcribe.py drops a segment whose whole text, lower case with every non-letter a space, equals an entry; an entry ending in * matches the start. The dropped segments stay in transcript.json under dropped. A short list from public reports of Whisper large-v3 hallucinations, not measured on this project's recordings.
